newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares rally 2.5 pct to new high.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares rally 2.5 pct to new high.

text.p: The composite index (IMKB-100) at Istanbul's stock exchange leapt 2.54 percent to a new all-time high close of 81,743.62 in strong volume on Friday, compared to Thursday's previous record of 79,719.25.

Brokers said the market continued its uptrend after piercing the critical 80,000 barrier in active morning trade after Thursday's 2.4 percent jump fuelled by the rejection of a censure motion against the government on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 23.9 trillion lira ($252.3 billion), after Thursday's 24.2 trillion($255 million).
"It was a healthy rise with intermittent profit-taking. If no negative (political) developments occur, the index will target 83,000-84,000 levels early next week," said Nazmi Sarikaya from Disbank.
Recent activity has been fuelled by hopes for speedier privatisation, easing Treasury-bill yields and an announcement that the Treasury would not borrow in domestic markets until November.

The index leapt 7.3 percent this week after last week's 0.6 percent correction. Gains totalled 26.2 percent since September 13 in a medium-term uptrend which began with the breaching of 65,000 barrier.
